msContents.summary: This manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya was digitized as part of the National Mission for Manuscripts.

handNote.desc: The catalogue entry describes this as Maithili script.

encodingDesc.p: IAST transliteration. ẏa for ya with nukta. t__ for final -t.

lg.l: kathayanti hitārthānāṃ prabhāvān adbhutāṃs tathā ||
lomasan dharmmatatvajñaṃ paryapṛcchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman bhaẏārttaṃ śaraṇāgatam |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana ||
ekata kratavaḥ sarvve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhaẏabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam |

i
dam eva purā devās tulāẏāṃ samatolaẏan |
prāṇarakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate |
atraivodyaharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |

indrasyāgneś ca samvādaṃ
śiver auśīnarasya ca |
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpam |
indraḥ śyenaṣ kapoto gnir bbhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ |

athoruṃ nṛpateṣ prāpya kapotaḥ śye
najād bhaẏāt__ |
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhaẏavihvalaḥ |
tataḥ śivim upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedam vacasus tadā ||
dharmmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājānaṃ mahīkṣitam |
sarvvadharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathan dharmmañ cikīrṣasi |
bhavān tvaddhaṃ hi dānena satyenānṛtavādinam |

kṣamayā
krūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jaẏet__ |
nopakārapare py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare pi tvam upakaraparo yathā |

ahite hitabuddhi
s tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt__ |
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ |
tad eṣa vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |

taṃ rakṣan_ dharmmalobhena
dharmmam utsṛṣṭavān asi ||
santrastarūpaḥ prāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṅgamaḥ |
matsakāśam iha prāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnur ayaṅ khagaḥ |

tad evam āgatasyā
sya kapotasyābhaẏārthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhāṣ kuryyān tyāgaṃ sadbhir vvigarhitaḥ |
lobhād dveṣād bhaẏād vāpi yas tyajec charaṇāgataṃ |

brahmahatyāsaman tasya pā
pam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahatrīṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiṣ kvacit__ |

yathātmanaḥ priẏāḥ prāṇās sarvve
ṣāṃ prāṇinān tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāṣ prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarād vaṣṭair nnityasaṃsārasāgare |

jantavaṣ parikliśyante mṛtyos trasyanti te
tataḥ |
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā krodha eva ca |
āẏāso vā bhaven mūlam ekāṅgamāna ca tyajet__ |
mariṣyāmīti yad duṣkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāẏate

yukta
s tenānumānena paro parirakṣitum |
yathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaṣ priẏan tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priẏam |

sva rakṣyate jīvitam ātmāno yathā tathā pa
reṣām api rakṣa jīvitam ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppaẏiṣye kapotakam |
yad atra yuktam anyat te kartuṃ śyenāśu tad vada ||

āhārāḥ sarvvabhūtāni sa
mbhavanti janeśvara |
āhāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ hi |
śakyate nyair vināpy arthai rājan vartaẏituṃ ciraṃ |
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttaẏituṃ kvacit__ |

bha
kṣyād vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viśām pate |
visṛjya kāẏam yāsyanti pantānam apunarbbhavam |
mṛte ca maẏi sarvvam me putradāraṃ mariṣyati |

rakṣamāṇaṣ kapo
taṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān na rakṣasi |
dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmmaṣ parantapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmmaḥ sa dharmmaḥ sadbhir ucyate |

tasmād virodhan dharmmasya vicintya gu
rulāghavam |
yataḥ śreẏas tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavinirṇṇayam ||
nāsmād anyaṣ paro dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara |

prāṇinām bhaẏabhītānāṃ abhaẏa
m yat pradīyate |
varam ekasya satvasya pradattvābhayadakṣiṇā |
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṅkṛtam |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti daẏāparaḥ |

tasya dehā
d vimuktasya bhaẏam vidyate kvacit__ |
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutan tathā |
sarvvāṇy abhaẏadānasya kalān nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |

catussāgaraparyyantām yo dadyāt pṛ
thivīm imām |
yajec ca sarvvayajñais tu taẏor abhaẏado dhikaḥ |
api tyajed rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ |
na tv imaṃ bhaẏasantrastaṃ tyajed dīnakapotakam |

ya
smān nāsty aśubhaṃ kiñcit tena janmani janmani |
bhaveẏam aham ārttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśanam |
yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī maẏeṣa samudāhṛtā |

satyena tena
bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ |
āhārārthaṃ samārambhas tava cāẏaṃ vihaṅgama |
tad yatheṣṭan tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy aham ||

sa eva vihito
smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaṣ kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛja nāhāraiṣ kāryam asty aparair mmama |
śyenāṣ kapotān_ khādanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |

mā rājana sāratāṃ
jñātvā kadalīskandham āruha ||
nāham ucchāstramārggeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṅgama |
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo ẏan dhaḥ satvadaẏāparaḥ |

sarvvasattveṣu yad dā
nam ekasatve ca yā daẏā |
sarvvasatvapradānāt tu daẏaikāsmin viśiṣyate |
sarvve vedā na tat kurtyuḥ sarvve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryyāt prāṇi
nān daẏā |
vāṅmanaṣkarmmabhir yye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
daẏādaśitapantāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |
gacchatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā |

yan na bhūtahitā
thāẏa tat paśor iva ceṣṭitam |
jaṅgamāni ca bhūtāni stāvarāṇi carāṇi ye |
ātmavat parirakṣanti te yānti paramāṅ gatim ||

prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ hi yaḥ śa
truḥ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
rājyaṃ śiver ahaṃ samyak praẏacchāmi tava dvija |

yad vā kāmaẏase tv anyaṃ varjjaẏitvā kapotaka
m ||
yadi rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī |
tataṣ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni praẏaccha me ||

anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śye
nābhiyācase |
etat te haṃ praẏacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi |
yadi priyan tat sujanaś cirād vadati vā na vā |
mama tu priẏam evaitat__ kasmād abhihitañ cirāt__ ||

adhru
veṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjjaẏed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhcetanaḥ |
yadi prāṇyupakārāẏa deho ẏan nopaẏujyate |

tataṣ kim upacā
rasya pratyahaṃ kṛẏate vṛthā ||
nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara |
tasmāt kapotena dhṛtaṃ praẏaccha tulaẏā mayam ||

tad evā
haṅ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase |
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syād yad vā tava vihaṅgama ||
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ |

prahṛ
ṣṭas tulaẏāmāsa kapotena saha prabho |
tyaktvāsutmasukhabhogecchāṃ sarvvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |
bhavanti paraduṣkhena sādhavo nityaduṣkhitāḥ |

dhriẏamānam tu tulaẏā ka
poto vyatiricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataṣ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ |
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit__ |

tataṣ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ sva
ẏam |
paraduṣkhāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
nāpekṣante mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahānty api |
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīṇare nṛpe |

devadundubha
ẏo neduṣ puṣpavṛṣṭiṣ papāta ca |
tatas tasya tadā buddhiṃ jñātvā dharmme stirāṃ śubhām |
śakraḥ svarūpam āstāẏa sahasaim enam abhāṣata ||

indro ham asmi bha
dran te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau ||
naitat pūrvve nṛpāś cakrur nna kariṣyanti cāpare |

mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ
tvaẏā |
parārthe tyajataṣ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tadā |
prāṇasaṃśaẏalubdhena na sā prāṇiṣu dehināṃ |
parārthaikāntakalyāṇī svastaẏetyantaniṣṭhurā |

tvayy eva keva
laṃ rājan_ karuṇā taruṇāẏate |
svakarmmapāśaiḥ sudṛḍhair bbaddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat__ |
tvaṃ jagadduṣkhamokṣārtha baddhaṣ karuṇaẏā nṛpa |

tathā sarvvātmanā vāpi doṣeṣu pra
kṛtaṃ tvayā |
yathaiṣām ātmasantāne vāsanāpi na vidyate |
prakṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca |
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottaratāṅ gataḥ |

paropa
kārajanmāno vidhātrā vihitās tu te |
sajalājaladās tvaṃ ca saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ |
ātmaprāṇaiṣ paraprāṇān_ yo naraṣ parirakṣati |

sa ẏāti tatparan dhāma
yato nāvarttate punaḥ |
prāṇair api tvaẏā rājan rakṣitaṣ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyesv anyeṣu kā kathā |

paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodara
mbharāḥ |
sa punar jjīvati ślāghyo yaṣ parārthaṃ hi jīvati |
kim atra citraṃ yat santaṣ parānugrahatatparāḥ |
na hi svadehaśītāẏa jāẏante candanadrumāḥ |

paropakā
ravyāpāraparo yaṣ puruṣas sadā |
saṣ padan tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat param |
paropakāraikadheẏaḥ svasukhāẏa gataspṛhāḥ |

jagaddhitāẏa jāẏante sā
dhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi |
yat svamāṃsāni gātrebhyaḥ tvaẏotkṛttāni pārthiva |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir llokān anugāmiṣyati ||

divyarūpadharaś caiva pālaẏitvā ciram mahī
m |
sarvvalokan atikramya brahmalokaṅ gamiṣyasi ||
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālaẏam |
rājāpi kratum iṣṭvā tu mumude devavac ciram ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuẏān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ |
sa vidhūẏeha pāpāni praẏāti tridivan naraḥ |
vicintya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvvajanasya durllabham |

śarīradānāt__
parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhūẏa lokatraẏabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau || ॰
